repeat_receipt.scope: six reversed-order independent checks of the same frozen package at original registered entries

pure_actor.scope: Independent original registered near-contact validation starts after a real 200 ms prefix, not frame0 full-task episodes. Prefix zero finger loads in grasp entries means new local acquisition, not autonomous approach/pregrasp qualification.

parent_diagnostics.scope: 4 separate parent u4991 diagnostic full replays. Native arrays exact in original receipt; Warp arrays differ by small rounding while failure steps/reasons and event phases/steps agree.

registration.units: inclusive absolute 2 ms steps, anchored to the original parent failure phase
registration.window_rule: Every step must exist and have the registered event phase. Short or different-phase windows are unscored. Compare physical milestones separately.
registration.tracking_only: Both sides must improve failure-related metrics on complete windows without earlier physical violation. Inspect load/contact failures independently; magnitude of joint tracking alone is insufficient.

archive_receipt.counting: one row for each absolute tick and lane, with episode membership checked across retained overlapping rings

archive_checks.note: Raw ring tensors not independently reloaded in this review; overlap row equality is the original receipt.

coverage.physical_definition: both finger force minima exceed the original contact threshold across the valid 20 ms interval

decision.positive_evidence: Pull grasp diagnostic acquired both finger loads after a zero-load prefix end: longest runs at u4991/u7500/u10000 were 0/460/362 ms. Reversed-order u10000 repeat confirmed 362 ms. Native push completed settle at u10000.
decision.counterevidence: The parent passed push open_5 and stable_grip on both official backends. Warp retained only open_5 at u7500 and neither at u10000; native u10000 also lost both. No contact phase events on either backend at u10000. Pull formal passes remained zero. All four full episodes ended in pregrasp with 0/75 best continuous ready ticks.
decision.tracking: At u7500 and u10000 none of the four preregistered failure-related windows contains the entire registered actual phase at the registered times. Partial windows provide no bilateral tracking basis for extension.
decision.justification: The new repeatable short-entry pull contact coexists with sustained loss of the opposite-side formal contact ability. The registered bilateral review does not support another 5000 updates.

automatic_review.scope: An unclassified result is pending review with the full registered criteria.

extension.interpretation: No extension is supported by the registered bilateral rule: repeatable new pull short grasp and substantial pull stable-hold improvement coexist with loss of parent push open_5 and stable_grip qualification in both backends. All u10000 full attempts still fail before grasp; all complete registered tracking windows are unavailable, so partial windows cannot justify bilateral tracking extension. This does not prove that all physical quantities regressed or that longer training could never help.

video.protocol_interpretation: The run plan requires retained continuous failure traces and first-failure evidence; immediate video generation is triggered by an original full-task success. No successes means the empty videos list is not a missed success-video obligation. No failure video is supplied; do not claim one exists.

limitations: No raw AutoDL .npz/.pt physical arrays or weights downloaded/reloaded. All raw-level equality/peak/minimum claims rely on original tracked receipts unless recomputed from committed scalar ledgers.
No new simulation, training, gate tuning, threshold changes or budget extension performed.
The local brief-entry acquisition evidence is an independent validation-start result and does not establish frame0 autonomous grasp or release success.

pull_short_grasp.scope: Existing validation near-grasp start with 200 ms real prefix, not a frame0 task.

physical_progress_details.interpretation: Pull acquisition/holding and no-contact medians improve, while push formal open/hold qualification is lost; a uniform total-regression characterization is not supported.
